description: This file defines the SocialCommitmentSubController class within the Goteo application, responsible for managing CRUD operations (list, add, edit, remove) for social commitment entities in the admin interface.

classes.name: SocialCommitmentSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing social commitment entities within the admin module, including editing, listing, adding, and deleting commitments.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier string for this controller, 'social_commitment'.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if the given user is permitted to access this controller, based on whether the node is a master node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing or creation of a social commitment, processing POST data, handling images, and saving updates.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Delegates to editAction to create a new social commitment.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of all social commitments.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Deletes a specified social commitment if it exists.
